subject: ela
intro: Eighth graders demonstrate command of capitalization, punctuation, and spelling. Key skills: using punctuation (comma, ellipsis, dash) to indicate a pause or break, using an ellipsis to show an omission, and spelling correctly. A dash sets off a strong break; an ellipsis (...) shows words left out or a trailing-off.

steps: An ellipsis marks omitted words or a trailing-off.
So it shows an omission or a pause/trailing-off.
solution.answer: An omission of words, or a trailing-off pause.

items.prompt: Add a dash to set off the break: 'She had one goal win the championship.'

steps: A dash sets off a strong break before the goal.
So: 'She had one goal, to win the championship.' (dash: 'She had one goal, win the championship.')
solution.answer: 'She had one goal, to win the championship.'
